anti_overlap: fd-romantic-driver-interaction-legibility covers narrator quality per driver; fd-romantic-simulation-graph-dynamics covers population-level emergent patterns; this agent covers per-driver relative weight and saturation behavior
decision_lens: Dramatic tension — the weighting scheme must produce a distribution of pairings where some are surprising, some are predictable, and some are tragic, with no single driver dominating all outcomes
focus: Whether the proposed driver categories have appropriate relative weights to produce dramatically interesting pairings rather than proximity-dominated uniformity
name: fd-romantic-driver-balance
persona: Game balance designer with deep experience in colony sim relationship systems — studied how DF, RimWorld, and CK3 relationship weights produce or fail to produce memorable social stories
review_areas: Evaluate whether 'time spent together' (raw proximity) will dominate all other drivers simply by accumulation — elves who work in the same building will always form attractions regardless of deeper compatibility
Check whether 'fandom-to-love pipeline' creates a celebrity concentration problem — high-prestige composers will attract disproportionate romantic attention from all fans, starving other pairings
Assess whether personality complementarity vs resonance creates two distinct attractor basins or whether one dominates in practice for most personality distributions
Verify that 'absence makes the heart grow fonder' mechanic won't create degenerate behavior where the optimal romance strategy is to artificially separate elves
Check whether the asymmetric attraction design requires explicit weight asymmetry rules or whether the driver combination naturally produces asymmetry at the population level
Review the 'underdog attraction' and 'prestige attraction' as opposing forces — do they cancel, compete, or sort elves into distinct attraction tiers based on their own prestige level?

severity_examples.condition: Proximity driver reaches saturation in fewer ticks than any meaningful artistic relationship can form
severity_examples.scenario: Proximity hours accumulate faster than any other driver can score, causing all romantic bonds to form between workshop-mates regardless of personality, aesthetics, or artistic admiration

severity_examples.condition: Fandom-to-love pipeline has no intensity cap or jealousy counterweight
severity_examples.scenario: The most-performed composer receives fandom from all elves, converting to romantic attraction for all of them simultaneously — creating social chaos that blocks other pairing patterns from emerging

severity_examples.condition: Axis-specific attraction rules produce less than 0.15 score differential between complementary and resonant cases
severity_examples.scenario: Complementary and resonant personality attraction are tuned to similar scores, producing neither the dramatic 'opposites attract' tension nor the warm 'kindred spirits' pattern

success_hints: A colony of 12 elves produces a varied web of attractions — some proximity-born, some artistic-admiration-born, some dramatic complementary-personality pairings — with no single driver producing more than 40% of all attractions.
task_context: The brainstorm lists 7 driver categories but defers the 'which should be primary vs secondary' question to the user — this agent provides the analytical framework for answering that question before implementation begins.
